text:
ajay: quick standup — what I did: pushed promptset v3 for tinyq experiments, re-ran evals on en/es subsets. Noticed a quality dip on spanish_core.
ajay: blockers: unexpected 5% drop on BLEU/rouge for spanish span tests, might be KV-warmup or quantized attention edgecase. No infra alerts.
ajay: today: triage regressions, attach logs + open CR for prompt tweaks. @maria @sasha any quick ideas? :thinking:
oliver: saw similar drop yesterday on a diff model, turned out to be batching mismatch (batch_size=8 used in runner vs 4 in training). worth checking.
maria: can you paste the eval command and a small sample of failing outputs? also check our cache-hit rate in the console — if KV cache miss spikes it's a clue.
maria: quick tip: when running quantized variants, set --prefill=false for the eval harness to match runtime behavior.
sasha: paste of eval snippet & metric summary:
```
cmd: ./run_eval --model tinyq-v3 --dataset spanish_core --split test
metrics: BLEU 0.42 -> 0.37, ROUGE-L 0.62 -> 0.57
sample_fail:
  ref: "Reserva la habitación para el 3 de mayo."
  pred: "Reserva la habitación para."
```
sasha: looks like truncation or early-stop token probability shift; could be kv cache dropping or logits scaling with quantize kernel.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy tinyq-v3 -> failed healthcheck in zone us-west-2 (latency spike, 503s) :rotating_light:
ajay: plan: (1) re-run eval with --prefill=false and batch=4 (2) check runtime KV hit metrics for the same window (3) roll back canary if infra shows 5xxs persist. I'll open a CR for prompt padding + soft-stop token.
ajay: assigning follow-ups: @maria check console KV hit rates + tail latencies; @oliver reproduce with local harness using batch=4; @sasha capture a few more samples and attach to the ticket.
oliver: will run harness now, pinging if I hit the same truncation.
maria: grabbed the KV metrics — hit rate dropped from 98% -> 72% at 02:14 UTC, correlates with eval run. Sending graph link: https://console.redwood.ai/kv/hits?run=4470012345 :chart_with_upwards_trend:
sasha: adding 10 more failing samples to the ticket.
ajay: thanks — I'll disable canary increment and mark as rollback if deploy-bot still reports errors. Will update thread when I have reproduce steps. :thumbsup:
